001_N: ["You tap your card for a coffee. Five dollars.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b"}]
002_N: ["Beep. And the number above your head drops by five.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b"}]
003_N: ["Not five dollars. Five minutes. Of your life.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b"}]
004_N: ["What if every dollar you spent cost you one minute of your life?",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b"}]
008_N: ["And one day, you'll get a bill that isn't even yours.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b"}]
